description: New Zealand Heirloom Sent to Koanga Institute by Rhonda Wood from her grandfather's old collection (Noel Burnett from Waitui). Described by her as an early commercial variety, her grandfather's favourite because of the perfect regular Easter egg size that he loved to bake in their jackets.
